$comment: Research configuration. Dry-run only, no credentials, no live keys.
The exchange block exists solely so Freqtrade can download public candles;
backtesting and hyperopt never authenticate. Leave key and secret empty —
if this file ever needs a real key, something has gone wrong.
$comment_fees: Costs are charged explicitly rather than left at a default. The measured
failure of the existing strategy was frictional, not directional — 31
winning trades that still lost 6.16% — so a backtest that understates fees
would reproduce exactly the mistake this research exists to avoid.
